description: This file defines the class 'Image_Graph_Layout_Matrix', which manages a matrix layout for graphical elements, including methods for initialization, setting entries, and rendering.

classes.name: Image_Graph_Layout_Matrix
classes.description: A class for managing a matrix layout of graphical elements, with methods for construction, setting, and rendering matrix entries.

methods.name: Image_Graph_Layout_Matrix
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the matrix with specified rows and columns, optionally auto-creating plot areas.

methods.name: _pushEdges
methods.description: Private method to set edge positions for a cell in the matrix.

methods.name: getEntry
methods.description: Returns the element at a specified row and column in the matrix.

methods.name: setEntry
methods.description: Sets an element at a specified row and column in the matrix and updates edges.

methods.name: _updateCoords
methods.description: Updates the coordinates of all elements in the matrix layout.

methods.name: _done
methods.description: Outputs the layout to the canvas, returning success status.
